Allocating a second base would duplicate Handle/fields. Next successor will add a typed field borrow to the generic visual owner and project Character's existing fields. Teardown: manager unpublishes receiver first, then factory.erase_after_unpublication(identity); native actor.close destroys session/injury/FSM/animation/controller references in the existing order. World pin remains live through those destructors. Source visual/root/body lease cleanup must be integrated before claiming full Character deleting-destructor lifecycle.
